title: ComposerMention
description: composer.mention@1: one thing the composer's @ menu can insert, from GET /api/v1/mentions on OpenVibe.Network. kind person (a person the caller follows first, then a public person), repo (a repository on OpenVibe Git the caller can see), site (a first-party OpenVibe site) or file (a file of the message's own context). `id` is the stable id inside its kind, `label` what the menu shows, `handle` the @name when the kind has one, `avatar` the picture, and `url` where choosing it links.

kind.description: What is mentioned. The same person is a person; a repository on OpenVibe Git is a repo; a first-party OpenVibe site is a site; a file of the message's context (an attachment or a repository file) is a file.

id.description: The stable id inside the kind: a usr_… subject for a person, owner/name for a repo, a site id for a site, a path or attachment id for a file.

label.description: What the menu shows (a display name, owner/name, the site's name, a file name).

handle.description: The @name when the kind has one: a person's username, a site's short name. Absent for a repo or a file.

avatar.description: Absolute URL of the picture to show beside the label. Null when the kind has none (a file, a site without a mark).

url.description: Absolute https URL where choosing the mention leads: the person's profile, the repository, the site's home or the file.
